description.short_caption: Segmented tapeworm specimen, likely Taenia species, in a petri dish.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a segmented, ribbon-like organism consistent with a tapeworm, displayed in a petri dish. The proglottids (segments) are clearly visible, with some containing darkened areas suggestive of reproductive structures. The specimen is pale and translucent, typical of cestodes. The setting suggests it was removed from a host, likely as part of a diagnostic or therapeutic procedure.

description.short_caption: Microscopic examination of stool showing oval eggs, 20x magnification.
description.detailed_description: This image shows numerous oval-shaped eggs with a smooth outer shell, viewed under a microscope at 20x magnification. The eggs are uniform in size and shape, with a translucent appearance. The background is bright, suggesting a light microscopy technique. These findings are consistent with parasitic eggs, likely from a helminth infection.

description.detailed_description: The image shows a segmented, ribbon-like structure consistent with a tapeworm specimen placed in a clear petri dish.
